name: context-meter
description: A band above the prompt with what fills the context window, by category, a countdown to when the prompt cache expires, and a Compact button. Starts off: /context-meter on turns it on

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: auto: 1h on a Claude subscription, 5m with an API key (Claude Code's defaults; a mod cannot read the real setting). Pick 5m or 1h if you set promptCacheTtl or are drawing on usage credits.

breakdown.title: How the categories are counted
breakdown.description: summary: estimated locally, no requests. full: counted with the token-count API after every turn, as /context does.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: on: the band shows while the mod is on. off: the mod measures without a band, and /context-meter status answers with the reading. /context-meter on and off switch the whole mod, for every session.
